rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; f4952 p.3 Line4a includes taxable interest and ordinary dividends in this screened slice. ScheduleB line2 is the sum of interest.amount entries; Form1040 line2b copies that subtotal. ScheduleB line6 supplies the same ordinary-dividend total carried to Form1040 line3b. The alternative references identify the same prepared-return amounts; this does not assert equivalence for independently inconsistent boundary overrides or every unknown/refusal ordering.

Ruling: equivalent within scope; project retained. The project sums Schedule B line 2 (total interest before the excludable savings-bond interest on line 3, which is refused and zero) and Schedule B line 6 (ordinary dividends); the second sums Form 1040 lines 2b and 3b, which are those Schedule B totals carried to Form 1040. Same values within scope (Form 4952 instructions pp. 3–4, line 4a).

Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 3, Line 4a: "Gross income from property held for investment includes income, unless derived in the ordinary course of a trade or business, from interest, ordinary dividends (except Alaska Permanent Fund dividends), annuities, and royalties." The amounts are the project's: Form 1040 line 3b copies Schedule B line 6 (Form 1099-DIV box 1a), and Alaska Permanent Fund dividends are on Schedule 1 line 8g, not Schedule B. No value difference. The candidate attaches f4952.unsupported to line 4a, a screen the project reads only when the form is used. Every completed-return difference is on a return that does not use Form 4952: line 1 $0, no 2024 carryforward and no line 4g election (checked on the recorded completed witnesses with --explain). It follows structurally: when the form is used, the project's line 8 reads line 5 and line 2, which refuse on f4952.unsupported and f4952.alternative_allocation, so a completed project return with that screen unanswered or answered Yes has no investment interest, carryforward or election. On such a return every amount is zero whatever the screens say, and the candidate still asks or refuses on them, an answer the source does not need (the over-refusal PENDING-6 of the credits-misc package removed from the project). Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f4952.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 210 partial records; 2,205 comparisons): 2,068 agree; 103 candidate-unknown, 34 candidate-refuses; on completed returns 20 candidate-unknown, 9 candidate-refuses. Completed witness 2 (classm.f8962.1.deepseek): project $0.00, candidate refuses.

Ruling: representation; f4952 p. 3, Line 4d: "Net gain from the disposition of property held for investment is the excess, if any, of your total gains over your total losses from the disposition of property held for investment." Form 1040 line 7a floored at zero is Schedule D line 16 floored at zero (line 7a is line 16, or the line 21 loss, or capital gain distributions that line 16 carries through line 13). Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f4952.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 210 partial records; 2,205 comparisons): 2,205 agree; no difference.
Ruling: equivalent representation; project retained. Line 16 floored at zero equals the larger of zero and line 16.

Ruling: representation; f4952 p.3 Who Must File gives interest/dividends less qualified dividends, no other deductible expenses and no carryover as the exception. The project line5 is zero on its admitted slice and refuses unsupported expenses; the reply tests that screen directly. Both require filing for a positive line4g election under pp.3-4. This ruling is limited to completed supported facts, not missing-screen equivalence.

Ruling: model error; f4952 p.4 Line4g says to make the election by entering the elected amount on line4g. A positive declared election therefore needs this form even if the interest-expense deduction otherwise meets the p.3 filing exception. Both returned predicates omit the positive-line4g condition. For investment interest $100, ordinary nonqualified investment income $200 and declared elected dividends $50, the exception can hold while the election still requires Form4952. The project asks whether the form is needed for the deduction or declared election; no new owner scope choice is made.

Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 4, Line 4g: "To make the election, enter on line 4g the amount you elect to include in investment income (don't enter more than the sum of lines 4b and 4e)". The candidate keeps the Stage 20 change (it tests line 3, so a 2024 carryforward alone can require the form; f4952 p. 3, Who Must File: "you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense. Exception. You don't have to file Form 4952 if all of the following apply. ... You don't have any carryover of disallowed investment interest expense from 2024.") but drops the project's disjunct for a positive line 4g, so a filer whose only reason to file is the election is told the form is not required. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f4952.json`, 1,866 comparisons): 1,603 agree, 37 value (12 on completed returns), 158 project-refuses, 67 project-unknown, 1 candidate-refuses. Every recorded value witness is project true, candidate false with an election: witness 0 (classm.f8889.1.deepseek, completed) line 4g $3,846; witness 9 (classm.retirement.4, completed) line 4g $6,963. The refusals are the cited screens f4952.unsupported and f4952.alternative_allocation and upstream sd.other_forms (witnesses 1-4), the unknowns withheld screen answers (witnesses 12-15), and the candidate refusal an upstream sb.fbar_required (witness 16). Same ruling as the earlier rounds. The Stage 20 change itself agrees with p. 3: line 3 adds the line 2 carryforward, and a filer with a carryforward is outside the exception.
